source.text: Histologically confirmed stage IB, II, or IIIA NSCLC
stage IB, II, or IIIA NSCLC
Documented ROS1 rearrangement in primary tumor
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1
Co-mutations of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)
Currently have or have a history of interstitial lung disease (ILD), drug-related pneumonitis, or radiation pneumonitis that required steroid treatment
Have active and clinically significant bacterial, fungal, or viral infection, including hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV)
known human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)- or acquired immunodeficiency syndrome-related illness
